description.name: Entry
description.text: Seven single hybrid attacks (0.90/3.10 each) capped at 19999, grants [Attach Holy 3 with Stacking], [Zenith Mode], [Zenith Mode: Cecil (Paladin) (Holy)] and [Damage Cap +10000] to the user

description.name: Zenith Mode: Cecil (Paladin) (Holy)
description.text: Increases [Holy Infusion] damage bonus by 20%, cast speed x1.10 for PHY attacks and BLK, WHT, BLU, SUM or NAT attacks that deal magical damage, Holy abilities trigger 1 additional time, casts Spirit Attack: Cecil (Paladin) after using a Holy ability (max 1), maximum HP +1500, grants [Astra] after taking the next action, removed if the character hasn't [Zenith Mode]

description.name: Paladin Force+
description.text: Five single attacks (1.20/1.25 or 3.87/4.02 each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Saint's Fall+
description.text: Six single hybrid attacks (? or ? each) capped at 9999/19999 after 0-2/3+ uses

description.name: Spirit Attack: Cecil (Paladin)
description.text: Grants [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] to all allies, grants [Holy Ability Quick Cast 3], [MND +50% (15s)] if the user's ATK is less than or equal to their MND, [100% Critical 3] if the user's ATK is greater than their MND, to the user (max 1)

description.name: Attach Holy 3 with Stacking
description.text: Increase Attach Holy Level by 3 and increase Max Attach Element Level by 2, up to Attach Holy 3

description.name: Zenith Mode
description.text: Replaces certain Hero Abilities, certain Hero Abilities don't consume uses, after the duration the status only expires after the character takes an action
